name: Reproduction
author: GlossX
description: Reproduce a paper's core result: extract the setup from the paper with citations, delegate a minimal implementation to a sandboxed coding agent, and report what matches the paper.

capability.card: Reproduce or implement a paper's method: extract datasets, hyperparameters and metrics with citations, have a sandboxed coding agent build and run it, report gaps.

args.question: Everything needed to reproduce the main result: task, datasets and splits, model architecture, hyperparameters, training procedure, evaluation metrics and the reported numbers.

args.task:
Request: {{goal}}

Implement a minimal, runnable reproduction of the paper's core method in this workspace. Put the entry point in run.py and a README.md that lists every setting you took from the paper, every setting you had to guess, and the command to run. Run a small smoke test and report its output. Setup extracted from the paper (JSON): {{setup}}

args.instructions: Write a reproduction report: (1) the setup as stated in the paper, every item cited; (2) what the coding agent implemented and ran, taken only from its output (say plainly if no coding agent was available or the step was not approved); (3) a checklist of paper settings marked matched, guessed or missing; (4) the next steps to close the gaps.
